This rice plot is my main work for the season, and since I own it I want to make it produce well. I will buy fertilizer if I can — rice needs it to give a good harvest, especially here in the North — but I have no money to waste, so I will use one or two bags spread across the plot. I will keep my local seed that I saved from last year because the agro-dealer is far and improved seed costs too much. My children and I will do most of the work, but for transplanting and harvest I must hire a few hands because rice cannot wait.
